\begin{document}
We parametrise the spin coherent state on the Bloch sphere by the polar angle $\theta$ and use
the half-angle amplitudes $\cos\theta/2$ and $\sin\theta/2$ of the up and down components.
Its polarisation along $z$ is
\begin{equation}
\cos^2\theta/2 - \sin^2\theta/2 = \cos\theta .
\label{eq:pz}
\end{equation}
